idea-plugin.name: Textile Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Write Textile inside Markdown files and see it rendered, live, in the normal Markdown preview. Made for drafting Redmine tickets next to your code.

Put the text into a ```textile code block, everything around it stays Markdown:

## Description

```textile
h3. What happens

Searching with the language filter set to *German* still lists English pages.
```

What you get

  • Textile rendered in the preview you already use, updated while you type
  • Redmine {{collapse(Label)}} sections that open and close
  • Images given by file name only, found next to the Markdown file
  • Redmine code blocks like <pre><code class="python">, colored with your IDE color scheme
  • A copy button that copies the raw Textile, ready to paste into Redmine

Example, source code and issues on GitHub.
